name: St Ives School

areas.summary: Moderate publicly visible evidence for curriculum (4 specific items). Listed provision includes mathematics, mathematics knowledge.

signals.text: Going well beyond statutory requirements, leaders ensure that the curriculum is skilfully interwoven across all subjects, to provide pupils with high-quality, innovative lessons that challenge and inspire them.
Pupils become highly competent in reading, writing, and mathematics knowledge and skills.
Specialist staff, who know their subjects well, challenge pupils to embed important foundation knowledge and apply this with increasing complexity.
In the early years, well-trained staff ensure that they provide high-quality opportunities for children to develop an early understanding of phonics, reading and early writing skills.

areas.narrativeSummary: The school website lists mathematics, mathematics knowledge.

areas.summary: Strong publicly visible evidence for enrichment and extra-curricular activity (6 specific items). Listed provision includes drama, art, music, in art competitions.

signals.text: Examples include enrichment weeks, such as the school’s finance festival, and clubs across sport, art and drama.
Extra-curricular activities, visiting speakers, clubs and trips are all artfully aligned, to provide the highest-quality, well-planned opportunities for pupils of all ages.

They also learn very well across the wider 8 © Independent Schools Inspectorate 2026 St Ives School – February 2026 curriculum, including in sport at both local and national levels, in art competitions, and music and LAMDA examinations.
Visits from architects, surgeons, finance experts and sports professionals are well chosen and planned at times when it corresponds with pupils’ wider curriculum learning.
The curriculum is enriched with visiting speakers from the police, fire brigade, a dentist and a trip to a local racetrack to learn about finance and helmet design.
